items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR

Approve an increase of $300,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 353 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-718R, Wastewater Enterprise Elevator Maintenance, Repair, and Modernization 2021-2024, with Star Elevator, for a revised cost limit of $2,650,344 and a revised duration limit of 1,590 calendar days, to provide additional funds and time to modernize the Oceanside Plant, Building 930 freight elevator and continue to service and maintain all Wastewater Enterprise and Southeast Community Center elevators

Accept work performed by Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc., under Contract No. WW- 733, As-Needed Sewer Inspection (FY23); approve Modification No. 3 (Final) increasing the contract duration by 124 calendar days, with no change to the contract amount, for a total contract amount of $1,767,793 and a total contract duration of 694 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and eleven months), to adjust the final contract duration to complete all contract work; and authorize final payment to the contractor

Award professional services Contract No. PRO.0309(R), As-Needed Relocation Coordination Services, to Visions Management in the amount not-to-exceed $4,500,000 and with a duration of five years, to provide professional relocation services to support the Water Enterprise relocation of programs, staff, and equipment to newly constructed or renovated facilities at 2000 Marin Street, San Francisco, and 1000 El Camino Real, Millbrae. President Arce exited the meeting at 2:48 P.M
Purchase and sale agreement 41.14-acre property located at 10115 Moccasin Switchback Road
items.text: Approve the terms and conditions and authorize the General Manager to execute a purchase and sale agreement and associated exhibits for the acquisition of an approximately 41.14-acre property located at 10115 Moccasin Switchback Road, in the unincorporated Town of Moccasin in Tuolumne County. The property is improved with an approximately 1,616-square-foot vacant modular dwelling unit. The negotiated $525,000 purchase price includes a $105,000 deposit to be credited against the negotiated purchase price, plus associated closing costs. If approved by this Commission, the acquisition is expected to occur on or before February 16, 2026. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action
